description: Parse, normalize and clean URLs offline: scheme, credentials (redacted), host type, port, path segments, decoded query parameters and fragment; registrable domain / subdomain / public suffix; IDN to punycode and back; RFC 3986 normalization (case, default ports, dot segments, percent-encoding) plus optional removal of known click-tracking parameters (utm_*, gclid, fbclid, msclkid, _hsenc, mc_eid...), query sorting and fragment stripping; flags URL shorteners. Up to 50 URLs. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/url-parse

stripTracking.description: Remove known tracking parameters from the normalized URL
